description: NO-REGRESSION fixture for saga #811 (issue #816 item 4). Unlike the characterization fixtures in this slice, this one asserts CORRECT behaviour that must survive the fix unchanged. It is the control that keeps the record honest: the maintainer's original report blamed excess arguments, and saga #811 corrected that — arity IS diagnosed. An excess literal argument to a primitive is rejected at PARSE (`ol-bad-token`, whose stage is `parse` per spec/error-model.md:110), which `execute()` returns without evaluating anything, so `events` is empty. The gap saga #811 is about is name resolution, not arity.
